0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 12th in the West) host the Denver Nuggets (1-1, on a one-game win streak and 8th in the West) in the Pelicans' fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain. The Pelicans lost 141-135 in Denver on October 24, trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1, and were swept 0-3 in the 2025-26 series.
